Xiaomi Robotics Team, Jun Guo, Piaopiao Jin, Jason Li, Peiyan Li, Yingyan Li et al.
high · 2026-07-16

为什么值得看 这项工作把超过十万小时真实操作轨迹、自动生成的场景状态转移语言标注，以及预训练后训练流程结合起来，说明大规模视觉语言动作模型可以同时提升未见环境中的零样本机器人执行和复杂灵巧任务的少样本适应；对研究机器人基础策略、具身多模态学习和数据规模效应的人尤其有参考价值。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 59）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

视觉语言动作模型需要从大规模真实轨迹中学习可泛化的动作生成，并适配不同机器人本体与人类指令。

02
方法

方法先用超过十万小时的真实操作轨迹和场景状态转移语言标注进行预训练，再通过后训练对齐机器人本体和祈使式指令。

03
差异

其关键区别是采用可扩展的轨迹自动标注流程，把自然语言状态变化作为动作学习的条件信息。

04
证据

模型在机器人之家三百六十五基准上取得百分之五十七点六成功率，并在机器人道场上取得二十点零七平均分，摘要称其均超过此前最佳结果。

摘要

我们介绍小米机器人一号，这是一种视觉语言动作基础模型，能够在未见环境中直接遵循多样的语言指令完成广泛的移动操作任务，并以极少的微调数据高效适应新的下游任务。模型采用预训练和后训练两阶段方案：预训练使用通过通用移动操作设备收集的超过十万小时真实轨迹，并利用可扩展的自动标注流程为轨迹片段添加描述场景状态变化的自然语言；后训练则使模型适配不同机器人本体和人类常用的祈使式指令。实验显示，模型在预训练阶段随数据规模和模型规模增加而持续提升，这种扩展效果也传递到后训练；在多个仿真基准上，模型超过现有方法，在机器人之家三百六十五基准上达到百分之五十七点六的成功率，高于此前百分之四十六点六的最佳结果，在机器人道场上的平均得分为二十点零七，高于此前的十三点零七。

为什么值得看 这项工作把视频时间定位从单个片段预测改成可变数量的证据区间集合，并让监督和强化学习奖励都直接处理区间集合。对需要在长视频、多视角和多种查询中找证据的多模态模型研究者，它提供了不依赖脆弱片段匹配的训练方案；文本报告称其二十亿参数模型在七个基准上超过同规模基线，较对应骨干模型提升十四点二个平均交并比百分点。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 119）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有视频时间定位训练通常依赖一次性长视频标注或脆弱的片段匹配，难以处理多个、不重叠且数量不固定的证据区间。

02
方法

方法通过候选片段生成、独立定位、跨智能体共识、语义核验和边界细化构建多跨度监督，并以合并区间支撑上的一维时间瓦瑟斯坦距离和时间交并比作为奖励。

03
差异

时间证据在监督和优化阶段都被表示为区间集合，因此奖励能够在预测数量不同或区间发生等价碎片化时提供无需匹配的稠密反馈。

04
证据

二十亿、四十亿和八十亿参数版本相较对应骨干模型的平均交并比分别提升十四点二、十三点零和十八点一个百分点。

摘要

视频多模态大语言模型能够描述视频中发生的事情，却通常难以指出支持描述的具体时间位置。本文研究通用视频时间定位，将任务定义为在不同视频长度、领域、查询形式和视角下预测可变数量的证据区间集合，并提出以区间集合贯穿监督与优化的方法：构建多跨度监督数据集，使用时间瓦瑟斯坦距离奖励和时间交并比奖励进行训练。实验报告显示，二十亿参数模型在七个基准上超过所有同规模基线，四十亿和八十亿参数模型取得各自规模中最好的报告结果，并超过参数量最多三千九百七十亿的开源模型；三种规模相较其对应骨干模型分别提升十四点二、十三点零和十八点一个平均交并比百分点。

为什么值得看 这项工作把场景感知、相机运动、人体与手部运动、注视方向和深度估计统一到一个前馈模型中，避免依赖预计算相机轨迹或多个任务专用流程；对关注多模态时空建模和高效推理的研究者，它提供了一个可检验的整体建模路线。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 2）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

任务是从单目第一视角彩色视频同时恢复相机、人体、手部、注视和场景深度的时序一致四维表示。

02
方法

模型用掩码生成式第一视角变换器在单一前馈架构中联合预测多种视觉与运动信号。

03
差异

它不需要预计算相机轨迹，也不把场景感知和观看者自运动建模拆成彼此独立的任务。

04
证据

摘要称其在五个第一视角数据集上同时覆盖人体、手部、注视和相机跟踪，并保持有竞争力的深度估计与较快推理。

摘要

第一视角设备能够持续记录观看者与周围环境的交互，但现有方法通常依赖预计算的相机轨迹，将场景感知与人体自运动分开处理，并且推理速度较慢。本文提出锐视重建模型，从单目彩色视频中联合恢复观看者与视野的四维动态，通过掩码生成式第一视角变换器学习彩色视频、相机轨迹、注视方向、全身运动、手部运动和深度的联合分布，并在多个数据集上报告了准确率与效率方面的领先结果。

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对科学多模态模型碎片化的问题，把异构科学对象、自然语言、科学规律与专家知识放入统一推理模型中；若其在六十多个基准上的报告结果可复现，它将为同时处理性质预测、分子生成、蛋白质预测和科学图像任务的研究者提供比领域专用模型或工具拼接更统一的建模路线。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 11）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有科学人工智能能力分散在领域模型、工具增强语言模型和科学语言模型中，难以联合建模异构数据、科学规律与专家知识。

02
方法

模型将多种科学对象和语言指令映射到共享表示空间，结合规律与专家知识构造训练数据，并采用面向任务的解码器完成预测和生成。

03
差异

相较于按领域拆分的模型或外接工具的语言模型，该方法在单一模型中统一表示、知识对齐和多任务解码。

04
证据

模型使用覆盖二百项任务和数百万推理样本的语料库训练，并在六十多个科学基准上报告了与通用及领域专用模型的比较结果。

摘要

本文介绍了一个用于科学理解、预测和生成的统一多模态推理模型。该模型将自然语言指令与晶体结构文件、分子线性表示、蛋白质序列、光谱及科学图像映射到共享表示空间，并在数据构建和训练中融入科学规律与专家知识，再通过任务特定解码支持多类科学任务；模型使用覆盖二百项科学任务、包含数百万推理样本的数据集训练，并在六十多个科学基准上进行评测，论文声称其在多数基准上超过通用大模型，并在若干基准上达到或超过领域专用模型。

high · 2026-07-17

为什么值得看 这项工作把预训练与强化学习后训练放进同一套可控实验中，为判断预训练损失、数据量和模型规模如何影响强化学习收益提供了定量线索；它还表明，强化学习在难题上不只是放大监督微调已有的偏好，而可能找回几乎未被监督微调保留的正确动作，适合关注推理扩展和后训练机制的研究者。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 21）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

研究预训练选择如何影响强化学习收益，以及强化学习究竟如何改变模型的推理策略。

02
方法

在棋局文本上训练五百万至十亿参数模型，依次进行预训练、合成推理轨迹监督微调和可验证奖励强化学习。

03
差异

用受控的国际象棋环境替代规模庞大且难以归因的通用语料，系统连接预训练、监督微调与强化学习三个阶段。

04
证据

预训练损失可预测给定强化学习计算量下的性能，奖励曲线斜率随预训练词元数近似线性提升，数学文本实验也复现了该趋势。

摘要

强化学习已成为提升大语言模型复杂推理能力的核心方法，但现有研究通常将强化学习后训练与此前的预训练分开考察。本文以国际象棋为可控测试平台，按标准流程训练五百万至十亿参数的语言模型：先在人类棋局上预训练，再用合成推理轨迹进行监督微调，最后在具有可验证奖励的棋题上进行强化学习；研究发现，在给定强化学习计算量下，强化学习后的性能可由预训练损失较好预测，强化学习奖励曲线的斜率会随预训练词元数近似线性提升，而且强化学习在简单棋题上放大监督微调已经偏好的正确着法，在困难棋题上则会显现监督微调中几乎不存在的正确着法。在数学领域文本上训练十亿参数模型时，也观察到相同的预测模式：预训练更久的检查点达到更高的强化学习后性能，并在强化学习中提升得更快。

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对大语言模型后训练中的信用分配和跨模型知识迁移难题：它把教师信号并入强化学习目标，而不是在序列层面无条件模仿教师分布。若其结果可复现，研究者可在保留强化学习探索能力的同时获得更细粒度的训练引导，并扩大知识蒸馏从同系列模型到跨系列模型的适用范围。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 5）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

结果级强化学习监督过于粗糙，而在线蒸馏在教师相近或差异过大时都存在知识迁移限制。

02
方法

方法把教师监督加入强化学习目标，并结合带截断的反向重要性采样、负样本重置和序列级几何归一化。

03
差异

它选择性利用教师信息来引导强化学习，而不是对所有教师概率输出进行无条件散度匹配。

04
证据

案例研究和同系列、跨系列实验均报告其在单次通过率和多次通过率上超过标准强化学习与在线蒸馏。

摘要

大语言模型后训练对于提升推理、适应能力和对齐性至关重要。现有方法主要采用强化学习或在线蒸馏：前者依赖粗粒度的结果监督，导致信用分配困难且难以获得新知识；后者通过散度损失无条件匹配教师模型的概率输出，使相近教师提供的新知识有限，而差异较大的教师又难以提供有效指导。本文提出蒸馏强化学习，将教师监督融入强化学习目标，以提供细粒度引导、有选择地迁移新知识并避免无条件模仿；该方法包含带截断的反向重要性采样、负样本重置和序列级几何归一化三个组成部分。案例研究表明，该方法能够将学生模型原本无法获得的知识有效迁移过来；在同系列和跨系列蒸馏实验中，它在单次通过率和多次通过率上均明显优于标准强化学习与在线蒸馏。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 32）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

传统在策略蒸馏直接模仿教师输出分布，其设计基础仍缺乏充分研究。

02
方法

方法使用教师模型与指令调优前基础模型之间的逐词差异作为蒸馏奖励。

03
差异

04
证据

摘要

在策略蒸馏是强化学习中的一种后训练方法，它通过教师模型提供逐词监督，缓解奖励模型带来的限制。本文提出一种称为差分信号的新蒸馏奖励，用教师模型与其推理指令调优前基础模型之间的差异来刻画推理调优带来的变化，而不是直接模仿教师的输出分布；大量实验表明，该方法在数学、科学和代码推理基准上持续优于传统在策略蒸馏，并能让推理语言模型仅经过较短后训练便取得较强表现。

为什么值得看 它把视频模型的物理能力评测从“结果看起来是否合理”推进到“是否经过符合物理定律的推理过程”，并将失败定位到感知、公式化或演绎阶段。对视频世界模型研究者而言，这提供了检验多定律迁移、模拟到现实差距以及可见推理轨迹的具体工具，而不是只比较最终画面质量。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 36）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

现有基准主要检查视频输出的物理合理性，不能判断模型是否遵循了正确的物理推理过程。

02
方法

研究构建包含四百个经典力学视频的轨迹数据集，并采用感知、公式化、演绎三阶段协议与主观及客观混合评分。

03
差异

协议把生成视频视为可见推理轨迹，并按推理阶段、评测支柱和数据来源进行诊断。

04
证据

CategoryAreaModels and Training Methods / Architecture DesignTopicmultimodal / VLM architecture

high · 2026-07-16

Why it matters The paper combines over 100K hours of real manipulation data, automatically generated language descriptions of scene transitions, and a pre-training/post-training recipe. It shows that scaling a VLA foundation policy can improve both out-of-the-box execution in unseen environments and data-efficient adaptation to complex dexterous tasks, making it relevant to embodied multimodal learning and robot policy research.

Method brief
01
Problem

VLA models must learn generalizable action generation from large real-world datasets while adapting to robot embodiments and natural imperative instructions.

02
Method

The model pre-trains on over 100K hours of real manipulation trajectories with language annotations, then post-trains for embodiment and instruction alignment.

03

Abstract

We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Crucially, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that annotates trajectory clips with natural languages describing scene state transitions, providing rich and precise conditioning for action learning. During post-training, we aim to align these capabilities with robot embodiments and imperative instructions that humans naturally use to prompt robots. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong scaling behavior. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increased data scales and model sizes during pre-training. This scaling behavior directly transfers to post-training, where a stronger pre-training model yields better out-of-the-box real-robot performance in unseen environments. Furthermore, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 serves as a strong robot foundation policy that can be efficiently fine-tuned on complex, dexterous tasks with high data efficiency. Across multiple simulation benchmarks, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, it establishes a new state-of-the-art with a 57.6% success rate on RoboCasa365, surpassing the previous best of 46.6%. Furthermore, it achieves an average score of 20.07 on RoboDojo, significantly outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (13.07). Code and model checkpoints will be released. Method brief
01

Abstract

Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can describe what happens in a video, but rarely identify when the supporting evidence occurs. We study generalist video temporal grounding, in which one model predicts a variable-cardinality set of evidence intervals across video lengths, domains, query forms, and viewpoints. Existing training strategies are misaligned with this set-valued task: long-video labels often rely on brittle one-pass annotation, while reinforcement-learning rewards either fail to distinguish non-overlapping predictions or require fragile segment matching. TimeLens2 treats temporal evidence as an interval set throughout supervision and optimization. TimeLens2-93K constructs reliable multi-span supervision through caption-derived proposals, independent localization, cross-agent consensus, semantic verification, and boundary refinement. Our temporal Wasserstein reward computes exact one-dimensional \(W_1\) between uniform distributions over merged interval supports, providing dense, matching-free feedback under unequal cardinalities and equivalent fragmentation; temporal IoU complements it with precise-overlap feedback. Across seven benchmarks, TimeLens2-2B outperforms all size-matched baselines on every benchmark, while the 4B and 8B variants achieve state-of-the-art performance, surpassing open-source models with up to 397B parameters. The 2B, 4B, and 8B variants improve over their Qwen3-VL backbones by 14.2, 13.0, and 18.1 mIoU points, respectively.

Abstract

Egocentric devices, such as wearable front-facing cameras, provide a unique perspective for capturing the continuous interaction between a human viewer and the surrounding environment. A holistic and efficient multimodal model capable of reconstructing this 4D representation is therefore highly desirable. However, existing approaches often rely on auxiliary inputs such as pre-computed camera trajectories, treat scene perception and human ego-motion modeling as separate problems despite their strong interdependency, and suffer from slow inference time. To address these limitations, we present ReViV, the first unified framework for holistic egocentric 4D reconstruction that extracts both viewer and view dynamics from a single monocular RGB video. We formulate the task as learning the full joint probability distribution over multimodal signals, including RGB video, camera trajectory, gaze direction, full-body motion, hand motion, and depth. Powered by a Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer, ReViV operates within a single feed-forward architecture to simultaneously reconstruct the temporally consistent 4D reconstruction across the viewer and the view with fast inference speed. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks, including HoloAssist, HOT3D, ARCTIC, Aria Digital Twin, and TACO, demonstrate that ReViV achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency across holistic ego-body, hand, and gaze reconstruction, camera tracking, while maintaining highly competitive egocentric depth estimation without relying on heavy task-specific priors. Abstract

We present S1-Omni, a unified multimodal reasoning model for scientific understanding, prediction, and generation. AI for Science (AI4S) has advanced significantly through domain-specific models, tool-augmented LLMs, and scientific language models. However, model capabilities remain highly fragmented, limiting the joint modeling of heterogeneous data, scientific laws, and expert knowledge. S1-Omni addresses this gap by consolidating these capabilities into a single, coherent scientific reasoning model. The architecture of S1-Omni is built upon three core components: unified representation of scientific data, natural-world knowledge alignment, and decoding for domain-specific tasks. First, S1-Omni maps natural-language instructions and scientific objects, including CIF, SMILES, protein sequences, spectra, and scientific images, into a shared representation space. Second, it incorporates scientific laws and expert knowledge into data construction and training, enabling the model to reason from scientific evidence. Third, it performs task-specific decoding to support a broad range of applications, including property prediction, spectrum-to-molecular generation, protein site and structure prediction, and scientific image generation and editing. S1-Omni is trained on S1-Omni-Corpus, which covers 200 scientific tasks and contains millions of reasoning samples, and is evaluated on over 60 scientific benchmarks. It outperforms GPT-5.5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro on most benchmarks and matches or surpasses domain-specific models on several benchmarks. Overall, S1-Omni provides a practical path toward unified scientific modeling.

Method brief
01
Problem

02
Method

It trains models from five million to one billion parameters on human chess games, then applies synthetic-trace SFT and verifiable-reward RL on chess puzzles.

Abstract

Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to improving large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, yet RL post-training is largely studied in isolation from the pretraining that precedes it. As a result, two basic questions remain open: (1) how do pretraining choices (model size, data) shape the returns to RL compute, and (2) what does RL actually do to the model? These questions are difficult to study in the standard LLM setting: pretraining corpora are vast and uncontrolled, making it hard to attribute behaviors to pretraining versus RL, and systematic compute sweeps across both stages are prohibitively expensive. To address these challenges, we use chess as a controlled testbed for studying reasoning across the full pretraining-to-post-training pipeline. We follow the standard LLM training pipeline by pretraining language models from 5M to 1B parameters on human chess games, supervised fine-tuning on synthetic reasoning traces, and running RL on chess puzzles with verifiable rewards. Using this framework, we find that the post-RL performance at given RL compute level is well-predicted from the pretraining loss, and slope of the RL reward curves improves approximately linearly with the pretraining tokens. Beyond scaling, we find that RL does not simply sharpen the SFT policy: on easy puzzles it amplifies correct moves the SFT policy already preferred, while on hard puzzles it surfaces correct moves that were nearly absent under SFT. We further test whether our findings transfer beyond chess by training a 1B language model on math-domain text, where the same predictive pattern emerges: longer-pretrained checkpoints reach higher post-RL performance and improve faster under RL. In sum, we provide a quantitative account of the pretraining-to-RL interface and a controlled testbed for studying the science of reasoning across the full pretraining-to-post-training pipeline.

Enabling Spatially Fine-Grained DVFS in Neural Processing Units for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Yuqi Xue, Jerry Wu, Corey Yu, Jian Huang
high · 2026-07-17

为什么值得看 这项工作把动态电压频率调节从整片或粗粒度控制推进到神经处理器组件级控制，可利用大语言模型服务的服务级目标余量降低能耗，同时保持严格的延迟约束；对部署能耗受限的推理集群和加速器设计者尤其有价值。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

统一频率设置无法利用不同大语言模型张量算子在神经处理器组件间的瓶颈差异和服务级目标余量。

02
方法

系统将处理器核心流水线划分为独立电压频率域，并结合轻量跨域通信、亚微秒级控制指令和编译器两级贪心搜索选择调度与频率。

03
差异

相较于较粗粒度的动态电压频率调节，该设计能够在组件级独立调节电压与频率并协同优化指令调度。

04
证据

基于开源神经处理器核心的流水线实现和生产级模拟器及生产轨迹评估显示，能耗降低百分之二十五点八至百分之三十五点二，面积开销为百分之三点四五。

摘要

论文指出，大语言模型张量算子在神经处理器各组件上的瓶颈不同，因此应为不同组件分别配置频率。作者设计了支持空间细粒度组件级动态电压频率调节的神经处理器，通过分离电压频率域、降低跨域同步开销、扩展指令集，并由编译器在服务级目标约束下联合搜索指令调度和各组件电压频率；在开源神经处理器核心和生产级模拟器上的评估显示，能耗降低百分之二十五点八至百分之三十五点二，面积开销为百分之三点四五，且保持严格服务级目标。

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Pratyush Dhingra, Pramit Kumar Pal, Janardhan Rao Doppa, Partha Pratim Pande
high · 2026-07-19

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对混合专家推理的硬件瓶颈：非连续专家权重访问、输入相关的随机散发与聚集流量，以及同步聚合造成的尾延迟。它把非易失存储、易失存储、计算映射和片上网络联合设计，可能为部署大规模混合专家模型的加速器提供不同于常规硬件的存储与通信路径；论文报告最高十五点七倍加速和九点八倍能效提升。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

传统硬件难以高效处理混合专家推理中的非连续权重访问、随机令牌通信和同步输出聚合。

02
方法

系统采用三维多芯粒结构，将铁电场效应晶体管非易失存储、动态随机存取存储和异构计算映射结合起来，并配置专用片上网络。

03
差异

设计同时按注意力计算和专家路由的不同特征组织存储与计算，而不是仅依赖通用硬件和常规互连。

04
证据

实验结果显示，相比现有先进方案，系统最高加速十五点七倍，能效最高提升九点八倍。

摘要

混合专家架构已成为扩展大语言模型的重要方式，但在传统硬件上进行混合专家推理时，会受到非连续专家权重读取所需的大规模存储带宽、输入相关令牌路由产生的非确定性散发与聚集流量，以及同步聚合带来的尾延迟限制。论文提出一种三维异构多芯粒架构，结合铁电场效应晶体管非易失存储芯粒、动态随机存取存储易失存储芯粒、面向注意力与专家路由的计算映射，以及用于缓解随机令牌路由通信瓶颈的专用片上网络；实验显示其最高可获得十五点七倍加速和九点八倍能效提升。

Chang Eun Song, Sumukh Pinge, Tianqi Zhang, Sung Eun Kim, Tajana S. Rosing, Mingu Kang

为什么值得看 这项工作把倒排文件索引检索和距离计算直接下沉到三维闪存阵列，绕过主机或存储内处理器这一占检索时间约七成的瓶颈，为大规模检索增强生成服务减少数据搬运、带宽压力和能耗提供了硬件路径。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

现有存储内加速器仍依赖存储器外的主机或嵌入式处理器，无法消除向量检索中的带宽和处理开销。

02
方法

系统在三维闪存阵列内执行基于倒排文件索引的分层检索，并用双界限紧致相似性感知度量适配闪存串结构。

03
差异

轻量级对比适配器先把嵌入向量映射到适合该距离度量的空间，而不是直接执行常规软件相似度搜索。

04
证据

论文声称相较中央处理器基线速度最高提升四十一点七倍、能效最高提升七十一倍，相较现有存储内检索增强生成加速器吞吐量最高提升十二点一三倍。

摘要

检索增强生成通过从外部知识库检索相关信息来提高大语言模型推理的事实依据，但稠密向量检索带来了显著的延迟和能耗，并成为主要瓶颈。本文提出一种软硬件协同设计的存储内检索加速器，将基于倒排文件索引的分层检索深度嵌入三维闪存阵列，并采用面向闪存串结构的双界限紧致相似性感知距离度量和轻量级对比适配器，在接近软件检索召回率的同时提升性能与能效；相较中央处理器基线，其速度最高提升四十一点七倍、能效最高提升七十一倍。

Transition-Aware Backend Dispatch for Edge LLM Inference

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Alaaddin Goktug Ayar, Martin Margala
high · 2026-07-19

为什么值得看 这项工作把端侧大模型推理中的后端选择从静态配置或逐算子贪心，推进到考虑算子形状和后端切换代价的动态调度；在英伟达边缘设备上的回放中，相比最佳静态策略平均降低延迟百分之十七点四、能耗百分之十四点四和能耗延迟积百分之二十八点五，适合关注端侧推理性能与能效的系统研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录
方法解读
01
问题

静态后端分配忽略算子形状差异，而逐算子选择会因频繁切换增加开销。

02
方法

方法根据当前算子特征和上一算子所选后端动态选择支持的算子后端，并为其他算子保留静态分配。

03
差异

它将算子执行成本与相邻后端切换成本联合考虑，而不是只比较单个算子的最快后端。

Why it matters This work moves DVFS from chip-wide or coarse control to per-component control, using LLM serving SLO slack to cut accelerator energy while preserving strict latency targets. It is most relevant to energy-constrained inference clusters and NPU architects.

Source signalsarXiv indexed
Method brief
01
Problem

A single frequency setting cannot exploit different bottlenecks across NPU components or available SLO slack in LLM operators.

02
Method

The design partitions the NPU pipeline into separate voltage/frequency domains, adds lightweight cross-domain communication and sub-microsecond control, and uses a compiler two-level greedy search for scheduling and per-component DVFS.

03
Difference

Unlike coarse-grained DVFS, it independently tunes voltage and frequency for each component while co-optimizing instruction scheduling.

Abstract

As neural processing units (NPUs) evolve rapidly to accommodate the ever-increasing compute demand of large language models (LLMs), their power consumption is becoming a limiting factor. Our study shows that using dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) to exploit the service-level objective (SLO) slacks is a promising way to improve NPU energy efficiency for LLM services. And as tensor operators in LLMs exhibit diverse bottlenecks across NPU components, it is desirable to configure the frequency separately for each component to maximize their energy efficiency. In this paper, we develop eNPU that enables hardware and software support for spatially fine-grained, component-level DVFS on NPUs. eNPU refactors the NPU core pipeline to partition components into separate V/$f$ domains. It introduces lightweight cross-domain communication mechanisms to mitigate synchronization overheads across components, and extends the NPU ISA for sub-$μ$s DVFS control. eNPU uses a compiler-driven two-level greedy search to co-optimize instruction scheduling and per-component V/$f$ selection under SLO constraints. We implement eNPU's pipeline design on an open-source NPU core to verify its functionality and evaluate the energy savings with a production-level NPU simulator with various LLMs using production traces. eNPU reduces energy consumption of LLM services by 25.8%--35.2% with 3.45% area overhead on a TPUv4 chip, while preserving strict SLO guarantees.

Abstract

Furthermore, we design a specialized Network-on-Chip communication backbone optimized to mitigate the bottlenecks associated with non-deterministic token routing traffic across the combinatorial space of input-dependent MoE traffic patterns. Problem

Abstract

Existing software safeguards impose only behavioral constraints that can potentially be bypassed by sufficiently intelligent models. What is missing is a fine-grained, dynamic intervention mechanism at the architecture level. In this paper, we introduce a set of microarchitecture knobs which dynamically control the available hardware resources to limit AI performance at runtime. We evaluate candidate knobs spanning the GPU memory subsystem, across capacity, bandwidth, latency and frequency dimensions, and narrow down to four strong candidates: L2 size, L2 latency, L2 bandwidth, and shared memory port access rate. To minimize new logic and extra design cost, we build all four mechanisms from well-established microarchitectural primitives: cache way masking, credit-based rate limiting, latency insertion, and bank arbitration. We show that these knobs achieve high performance sensitivity (up to 80% performance cut at 1/8 resource availability), negligible implementation cost (<~10K flip flops), fast stabilization after dynamic throttling (5-80K cycles), and minimal collateral impact on the rest of the chip. Further, multi-knob analysis reveals combinations of knobs that amplify the performance degradation beyond the effect of each knob individually, which enables a broader range of performance targets.
